note: The capability -> test mapping is hand-authored judgment: a human decides which behavioral test proves a capability. Everything downstream of this file is mechanical. A capability whose named cases do not all pass is reported unproven or unsupported, never silently narrowed into a pass.

retained-run-control.summary: A retained run acquires the next exact control claim against the provider launch generation, and one operation identity survives an ambiguous retry.

cases: discovers the launch generation and acquires the next exact claim
reuses one operation identity when an ambiguous acquisition is retried
rejects a provider generation that does not advance
rejects a start with no admission hook before any provider call
awaits each admission before dispatch and before the start resolves

session-replay.summary: A reconnected session replays from an exclusive cursor with canonical event identity, and refuses a replay anchor it cannot validate.

cases: reconstructs in a new process, resumes after an exclusive cursor, answers, and cancels
preserves the CLI Bridge cursor while emitting its canonical event identity
assigns contiguous positive sequences when a replayable provider omits them
validates a replay anchor before skipping it

cancellation-acknowledgement.summary: Cancellation is acknowledged by operation id, applied once, and a worker that is already gone reads not_live or unknown — never success.

cases: acknowledges cancellation by operation id and never repeats its effect
rejects cancellation when the provider has no durable operation contract
repeating one operationId applies cancellation once and returns the same record
a worker that is already gone acknowledges not_live, and an unknown one stays unknown — never success
the cancelled worker reaches a terminal down state visible on the settle path

native-continuation.summary: A continuation stays on the same box and session id, and is verified against the platform before it proceeds.

cases: a refine continues the parent on the SAME box with the SAME session id
proceeds when the platform reports the session is live
throws when the platform reports the continued session is unknown

recursive-observation.summary: One execution journal carries a verified chain, keeps recursive terminal truth isolated per run, and refuses a tampered history before projecting it.

cases: persists one execution journal with a verified chain
fails closed on identity conflicts and detects mutation
never returns a trusted projection after a durable append failure
keeps run lifecycle and recursive terminal truth isolated per Runtime run
refuses mixed or tampered observer history before projecting it

cleanup-settlement.summary: Every owned box is torn down at loop end, partial live branches are reaped before a rejection, and an environment is kept when dispatch is uncertain but cleaned when unused.

cases: tears down every lineage-owned box at loop end
reaps partial live branches before rejecting the fanout
keeps an environment after dispatch becomes uncertain, but cleans an unused one

interaction-response-acknowledgement.summary: An interaction response is acknowledged, and replaying the same command digest returns the same acknowledgement rather than a second effect.

context-transfer.summary: A portable context is transferred between environments and the receipt proves the accepted transfer.
